mapper.select: SELECT user_id, voice_name, speech_rate_multiplier, volume_multiplier, created_at, updated_at FROM user_voice_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_voice_settings ( user_id, voice_name, speech_rate_multiplier, volume_multiplier ) VALUES ( #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, COALESCE(#{voiceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ko-KR-JiMinNeural'), COALESCE(#{speechRateMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, 1.05), COALESCE(#{volumeMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, 1.00) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = CASE WHEN (#{voiceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND voice_name <> #{voiceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (#{speechRateMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL} IS NOT NULL AND speech_rate_multiplier <> #{speechRateMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL}) OR (#{volumeMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL} IS NOT NULL AND volume_multiplier <> #{volumeMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL}) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE updated_at END, voice_name = CASE WHEN #{voiceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN voice_name ELSE #{voiceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END, speech_rate_multiplier = CASE WHEN #{speechRateMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL} IS NULL THEN speech_rate_multiplier ELSE #{speechRateMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL} END, volume_multiplier = CASE WHEN #{volumeMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL} IS NULL THEN volume_multiplier ELSE #{volumeMultiplier, jdbcType=DECIMAL} END
